function: Cloud QNN assigns APs to users; edge QNNs compute per-AP transmit precoding in downlink cell-free MIMO, maximizing user rate (pp. 1, 8-9).
system: Downlink cell-free MIMO: 4 APs with 2 antennas each, 3 users, no RIS; frequency band not stated (pp. 5, 10, Table III).
method: Two-stage quantum neural networks (cloud and per-AP edge circuits), gradient-descent training on a rate-based loss against ideal-capacity target; paradigm not named (pp. 7-9, 12).
data_channel: Own simulator: Rayleigh gains CN(0, d^-kappa) with ULA steering vectors and imperfect CSI; channel regenerated every iteration; no dataset or measurements (pp. 5-6, 10-11).
test_conditions: One simulated setup (4 APs, 3 users, 2 antennas) for training and evaluation; interference factor 0.6 or 0.4; 10^3 Monte-Carlo trials (pp. 10-11).
baselines: Non-learned: iterative search assigning each user the AP with highest SINR, with maximum-ratio precoding; no learned baseline compared (pp. 10-12, Appendix C).
metrics: Average sum rate (bps/Hz) versus training episode; training loss of cloud and edge QNNs; gradient-norm bounds; expressivity; required qubits (pp. 10-11).
complexity: Cloud N_iter gradient calculations, edges N_AP*N_iter; circuit depth O(N_neuron); O(N_layer*N_neuron) parameters; qubit counts per Lemma 1 (pp. 9-10).
q1_support: p. 10: "the Rayleigh channel gain is assumed". The channel is a custom simulator (Rayleigh gains with ULA steering, pp. 5-6); the paper names no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO, or measured data, so q1 is not met.
q2_support: p. 11: "is regenerated at each iteration". This is a fresh draw from the same Rayleigh model; Table III (p. 10) gives one configuration (4 APs, 3 users, 2 antennas); no unseen scenario, antenna or user count is tested, only the interference factor 0.6 or 0.4 is changed.
q3_support: p. 10: "an iterative search method". It is the only comparison and is non-learned (Appendix C, p. 12); Fig. 4 plots only QNN and search; no earlier learned method or standard network is compared, so the learned baseline is missing.
q4_support: p. 10: "manifests a circuit depth of" O(N_neuron) for the cloud circuit, with O(N_layer*N_neuron) parameters; p. 9 (Sec. IV-D) gives N_iter*G and N_AP*N_iter*G gradient calculations for Algorithms 2 and 3.
q5_support: p. 7: "libraries currently available, e.g., IBM Qiskit". Only a third-party library is named; there is no link to the authors' code or data, the data are simulated (p. 10), and no public dataset is used, so q5 is not met.
notes: Title on page 1 is Non-Centralized Quantum Neural Networks for Cell-Free MIMO Systems and the DOI matches. Area 3: the edge QNN output is the AP precoder. The cloud QNN learns AP-user assignment (above the physical layer) jointly with the precoding, so the work passes the above_phy check. Quantum circuits are the learned component. Table III and Fig. 4 were read from page 10 of the PDF image.
